PD Hook Gallop Handicap

runners_data.name: Simba's Pride

runners_data.name: Dragon Spin
runners_data.note: A natural hold-up horse who is mapped into midfield because the field is congested at the rear; jockey Dougie Costello will need to find a prominent position or accept midfield at best — strong 5f record on good ground (1W3P in 5 relevant runs) makes this a major player if pace assists.

runners_data.name: Golden Havana
runners_data.note: A natural hold-up performer redistributed into midfield by race shape; all form comes on Standard (AW) ground with zero wins or places on good ground in ten attempts — this is a significant going concern, and headgear (v=visor) suggests trainer is searching for improvement.

runners_data.name: Ice Cold Alex
runners_data.note: NON-RUNNER — strike from all race analysis; form profile shows consistent mid-pack finishes and no wins in nine starts, so no impact on race shape.

runners_data.name: U Turn
runners_data.note: Prominent-racing type returning from a lengthy 276-day absence for Tim Easterby; solid form on good ground (1W5P in 11 runs) but the layoff is the dominant question — if fit, his class is clear, but rustiness over 5f can cost vital early lengths.

runners_data.name: Riffa Spirit
runners_data.note: True hold-up horse mapped to midfield as a consequence of the crowded hold-up group; tongue-tie worn, and form shows a sole win on Standard ground at 6f — only 0W1P from 6 runs on good ground, and the switch to turf/good is not obviously in his favour.

runners_data.name: Arlo's Girl
runners_data.note: The confirmed pace-setter and likely leader from the gates; form has tailed off since her handicap debut win (runs of 4, 7, 8 since), suggesting she may be setting the race up for others rather than winning it, and Jack Nicholls (5lb claimer) adds to the risk.

runners_data.name: Bravo Hotel
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with a model of consistent placing without winning (33533 in recent form) and a 258-day absence for the Easterby yard; good ground form exists (0W2P in 5 runs) but needs pace to collapse ahead of her over this flat 5f to trouble the frame.

races.paceDynamic: Arlo's Girl is the confirmed front-runner here and, with only U Turn and Simba's Pride as genuine prominent types, she is likely to dictate from the gates on good ground over this flat Thirsk 5f. The pace should be honest but not suicidal — Arlo's Girl has the rail-to-rail profile and with just two horses pressing from the prominent positions, the tempo will be competitive without being a true burn-up. U Turn returns from 276 days off the track and Simba's Pride has been running regularly, so both will look to track Arlo's Girl, creating a race run at a controlled-to-moderate gallop that is unlikely to string the field out dramatically. This shape mildly favours prominent racers who can travel in the slipstream of Arlo's Girl and pounce in the final furlong, though a confirmed hold-up horse finishing fast on good ground remains possible if the pace does not ease. The field holds more hold-up types than the race map can accommodate at the rear — Dragon Spin, Riffa Spirit, and Golden Havana are all natural hold-up performers but are shown in midfield, and in this configuration Riffa Spirit (with tongue-tie) and Dragon Spin are most likely to secure a workable position slightly closer to the pace than their true style suggests.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Arlo's Girl Controls, Prominent Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Arlo's Girl leads at a sustainable pace and the prominent duo of U Turn and Simba's Pride track comfortably into the straight.
scenarios.body: Arlo's Girl sets a fair tempo, U Turn and Simba's Pride travel sweetly in second and third, and one peels off the pace to nail her inside the final furlong on good ground that suits everyone. This scenario rewards horses with a prominent racing style that can finish off a well-paced 5f, and Simba's Pride's strong form on good ground and U Turn's class make both compelling in this shape.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Runners Fly Late
scenarios.trigger: If Arlo's Girl and the prominent types push the pace hard enough to leave a gap for the finishing runners to exploit.
scenarios.body: A genuine clip up front stretches the prominent horses and leaves Dragon Spin and Riffa Spirit with daylight to pick off tired rivals in the final 100 yards, both having been nudged into midfield from their natural rear positions. Dragon Spin's solid 5f record on good ground and Riffa Spirit's prior win at 6f on similar ground make them dangerous if the pace genuinely sets them up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Arlo's Girl Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Arlo's Girl is allowed a soft lead by a compliant field and no runner has the momentum to catch her in the straight.
scenarios.body: With only modest pressure applied and the hold-up brigade too far back to close on a flat, straight track, Arlo's Girl simply gallops on unchallenged to the line at a generous SP. This scenario suits a front-runner with gate-to-wire ability on a track that historically does not punish leaders excessively on good ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Each-Way Shock
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too strong and the prominent horses fade, leaving an unconsidered hold-up type to pick up the pieces.
scenarios.body: Bravo Hotel, consistent without winning, or Golden Havana running fresh after a break and dropping in class, could benefit if the race burns out the front and midfield runners and the final furlong turns into a scramble. The flat 5f nature of Thirsk means late-runners must still cover ground quickly, so this outcome demands near-perfect execution.

watchPoints.text: Watch Arlo's Girl's early stride — if she is pressured by U Turn and Simba's Pride in the first furlong, the pace will be genuinely strong and hold-up runners Dragon Spin and Riffa Spirit become far more dangerous in the closing stages.

U Turn's 276-day absence is the race's biggest unknown; if he shows ring-rust in the first two furlongs and drops back, the prominent position projection collapses and the hold-up scenario becomes more likely.

Golden Havana's 0-from-10 record on good ground is a glaring concern — monitor in the market; if punters still back her heavily, it may indicate stable confidence that overrides the form, but the data strongly suggests this surface does not suit.

Dragon Spin is mapped in midfield but is a genuine hold-up horse — watch whether Dougie Costello attempts to settle him closer than expected or accepts the rear, as his finishing position will significantly alter the late-race dynamics.

Bravo Hotel is 258 days off the track; the Easterby yard has a 4/30 T14 strike rate suggesting runners returning from breaks are fit enough, but watch her market move — any significant support would flag stable confidence in her condition.

runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner; one win from 11 similar-going runs is modest, but controls the entire pace dynamic as sole lead horse — tactical advantage is significant in this shape; Thirsk's straight 6f suits a front-runner on good ground.|

races.paceDynamic: Space Bear is the one confirmed front-runner and will likely dictate from the front unchallenged at a sustainable gallop on good ground over 6f at Thirsk. With no rival willing to seriously contest the lead, the early pace is unlikely to be pressured, setting up a potentially straightforward lead-and-kick scenario for Space Bear and those travelling prominently behind. Frantic and Sugar Baby will be the closest pursuers in the prominent tier, tracking Space Bear through the first half of the race and poised to challenge from the 2f pole. This race shape — a single honest pace-setter, good ground, and a field dominated by hold-up types unable to get their natural position — strongly favours front-running and prominent-racing profiles, as hold-up horses will have cover but face the twin challenge of traffic and making up ground when the pace is not truly severe. The field holds significantly more hold-up types than the map can place at the rear: Record Day, Harlequin Bay, Taygar, Kings Merchant, and Emperor Caradoc are all natural hold-up runners — Space Bear, Frantic, and Sugar Baby are most likely to actually secure early position and dictate the shape.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Space Bear Controls Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Space Bear leads at a fair but uncontested pace and the hold-up horses cannot generate the late momentum to close.
scenarios.body: Space Bear dictates throughout at a sustainable 6f gallop on good ground and the front two or three home are among the prominent types who tracked the leader; hold-up horses run into traffic or find insufficient time to close. Frantic and Sugar Baby, both prominent-racing types with consistent recent form at the trip and going, are ideally placed to pounce if Space Bear ties up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closers Strike Late
scenarios.trigger: If Space Bear's pace is just quick enough to string out the field and the strong hold-up horses find clear daylight in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Emperor Caradoc and Taygar, both proven on this going and distance combination, have the tactical profile to benefit if the early pace is honest enough to weaken the prominent horses in the closing stages. Emperor Caradoc carries top weight but has three wins from five placed efforts on good 6f ground and is the most dangerous late mover in the field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Outstays
scenarios.trigger: If Space Bear sets a slightly stronger pace than expected, causing attrition in the prominent tier and leaving one prominent survivor to hold on.
scenarios.body: Frantic has the most consistent recent form of any runner in the field — four placings from four recent outings including two on good ground at 6f — and is capable of outstaying rivals if the pace stretches them early. Sugar Baby, a course and distance winner on good ground, is equally positioned to benefit if the front end opens up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Chaos Late
scenarios.trigger: If Space Bear and the prominent horses misjudge pace early, leaving an unusually strong late surge from the back of the field.
scenarios.body: Kings Merchant or Harlequin Bay, both redistributed hold-up types with the natural inclination to finish late, could snatch places in a messy finish if the front end over-reaches. However, neither has a strong recent record on good ground and this scenario requires a significant pace error at the front.

watchPoints.text: Space Bear (front-runner, Joanna Mason) — if she goes no pace at all, the entire hold-up field piles in late and the race becomes unpredictable; watch for her early fractional speed.|
Emperor Caradoc (top weight, 142lbs) — David Nolan will likely position him last or second-last and needs a clean passage; any traffic at the 1f pole turns a likely close run into a non-event.|
Taygar — has finished 2nd in three of his last three 6f good-ground runs; if he gets a clear run from midfield he is the most consistent each-way threat in the field.|

Frantic (George Downing) — unbeaten in terms of places (0 wins, 4 places from 4 runs); if the pace is honest and he tracks Space Bear throughout, watch whether he has a finishing kick or just stays on at one pace.|

Tactical Formation — 166 days off is significant; watch paddock demeanour and market movement; if fresh and moving well, the Fahey yard has strong 14-day form (8/63) and this horse has placed on good ground at the trip before.|

races.paceDynamic: Kosometsuke is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate from the outset over Thirsk's flat 7f, setting what should be a measured, sustainable pace without significant pressure from behind. Inside Story, It Just Takes Time, and Zarvali will track closely in the prominent group, while the hold-up brigade — Degale, Ormolulu, Mr King, and This Farh — will need to find room from the rear on a track that does not always reward closers at this trip. This field holds more genuine prominent types than can all secure their natural positions: Woodstock is a true front-runner/prominent type likely to be pushed back into midfield, while Gressington and Fuji Mountain are natural hold-up horses similarly redistributed forward on the pace map but unlikely to dictate in practice. With only one horse controlling the tempo and no genuine pace battle to stretch the field, this race shape strongly favours prominent-to-handy runners who can sit just off Kosometsuke and pounce in the final two furlongs, rather than hold-up horses who will face a wall of horses on a gallop that may not be fast enough to string the field out.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Kosometsuke Controls; Prominent Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Kosometsuke sets an uncontested moderate gallop and the race sets up for those tracking just off the pace.
scenarios.body: Kosometsuke bowls along at a comfortable clip with Zarvali, Inside Story, and It Just Takes Time close enough to strike; the hold-up horses never see daylight in time. Prominent runners who have proven form at 7f on Good turf — particularly Zarvali and Inside Story — are best positioned to pounce as the leader's advantage evaporates in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse; Leader Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If the tempo is genuinely slow and the field bunches, gifting Kosometsuke an uncontested lead that is never reeled in.
scenarios.body: Kosometsuke steals a march on a flat track with no challenger, and the hold-up horses find the pace too steady to overhaul at the death. This Farh, despite natural hold-up tendencies, has shown enough tactical speed to stay competitive if the race crawls.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Storms Late
scenarios.trigger: If Kosometsuke sets a stronger gallop than expected and the race develops a genuine end-to-end tempo.
scenarios.body: A faster pace stretches the field and creates space for late runners; Degale and This Farh, both effective on Good going, get a clear run and pick off tiring rivals from the rear. Ormolulu would also be in contention if racing straightforwardly, though recent form gives pause.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Types Benefit From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If early jostling for position causes trouble in running and disrupts both the pace-setters and hold-up horses.
scenarios.body: Woodstock, pushed back from her natural prominent position, finds herself perfectly placed in midfield if the race becomes messy and rivals interrupt each other's runs. Fuji Mountain, another redistributed type, could benefit similarly if the field fans wide.

watchPoints.text: Woodstock is a natural prominent runner likely to be shuffled back into midfield by Kosometsuke's presence — watch whether Joanna Mason fights for position early or accepts the rear-of-prominent berth, as it materially changes the race shape.

Fuji Mountain has unproven stamina at 7f — if the race is run at a fair clip, watch for the horse to tie up in the final furlong, potentially causing interference among the hold-up group arriving late.

This Farh is wearing headgear (hood) and has been racing very frequently (10 days since last run) — watch for the horse to race keenly early if the hood increases alertness, potentially compromising the hold-up plan.

Gressington has a record of 0 wins and 0 places from 15 runs on similar going — watch for this runner to finish out of contention if the pace is not strong enough to create a gap, confirming the pattern.

City Captain is a non-runner — connections and market followers should note this removes a prominent-style runner from the field, which slightly reduces pressure on Kosometsuke and further consolidates the uncontested lead scenario.

races.paceDynamic: Spendmore Lane is the confirmed front-runner and, with no serious challenger for the lead, should secure a comfortable, uncontested gallop from the front on this flat 5f Thirsk track. Military Girl, Beaumadier, and King's Crown are all genuine prominent types who will push up behind Spendmore Lane, creating a respectable pace that should remain steady rather than furious. The field contains more prominent and hold-up types than the track map can accommodate — Khabib, Pal Joey, and Hover On The Wind are all natural prominent or hold-up runners who will find themselves shuffled into midfield given the number of horses seeking forward positions. With a single unchallenged pace-setter dictating a measured gallop on good ground, this race shape moderately favours hold-up horses with a strong late kick, provided the tempo is sufficient to string the field out — though prominent racers tracking the leader in the slipstream are equally well placed if the pace is too steady to fully expose them.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace, Prominent Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Spendmore Lane sets a moderate unchallenged gallop and prominent trackers travel sweetly in behind
scenarios.body: Spendmore Lane controls from the front while Military Girl and Beaumadier settle in the prime tracking positions, and with no kick required to close down a true sprint, the prominent duo hit the line full of running; Military Girl's recent consecutive wins on good ground and Beaumadier's consistent course profile make them the chief dangers to the leader

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Closers Land Blow
scenarios.trigger: If the early tempo is brisk enough to compromise the prominent horses before the final furlong
scenarios.body: Spendmore Lane sets enough pace to drain the leaders, and the hold-up runners Marajito, Emerald Harmony, or Le Beau Garcon arrive late with momentum down the Thirsk straight; Marajito's sole recent win came on good ground over this exact trip, and Emerald Harmony's three placings at this level on similar ground give her strong credentials for this scenario

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Spendmore Lane Front-Runs Clear
scenarios.trigger: If the gallop is steady enough that Spendmore Lane is never headed and the hold-up runners cannot peg back the gap
scenarios.body: With no pace pressure to force Spendmore Lane off the bridle, William Pyle can dictate margins throughout and simply quicken entering the final furlong; the prominently-placed King's Crown and Beaumadier, unable to close from tracking positions, take the places behind

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Redistributed Types Cause Trouble
scenarios.trigger: If early traffic issues in a bunched midfield force Khabib, Pal Joey, or Hover On The Wind wide and disrupt the race shape
scenarios.body: Horses unable to get their natural rhythm in traffic lose ground at a critical early stage on a flat sprint track where position cannot easily be recovered; those who escape the trouble cleanly — most likely Military Girl from a prominent position or Marajito switching out late — benefit most

watchPoints.text: Military Girl and Beaumadier are both prominent types likely to secure the prime tracking position behind Spendmore Lane — whoever gets the cleaner berth at the head of the chasing pack holds the strongest tactical advantage in what looks a steady-paced race
Spendmore Lane's going record on good turf (2 runs, 0 wins, 1 place) is the key flag against the leader — if the surface catches him out, the race opens significantly for hold-up closers

Khabib, Pal Joey, and Hover On The Wind are all true hold-up or prominent types squeezed into midfield by the race shape — watch for early crowding and bumping as multiple horses are forced out of their natural positions in the opening furlong

Beaumadier returns from an 84-day absence with a 7lb claimer on board and all recent form on non-good surfaces — any market support for this runner should be noted given the unknowns, as it would suggest stable confidence despite the flags

Emerald Harmony and Marajito are the two hold-up runners with the most convincing good-ground profiles and recent form — if the pace from Spendmore Lane is brisk rather than dawdling, these two are best placed to close late down the Thirsk straight

runners_data.name: Dc Cogent
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with consistent placed form over 5f on good ground; Bryan Smart has had no winners from 12 runners in 14 days and Dc Cogent's highest OR of 64 means he carries the most weight in the field — consistent but needs to produce a career-best effort.

runners_data.name: Dandy Dinmont
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner for Nigel Tinkler who is 6/26 in 14 days — one of the better-placed trainers in this field; Dandy Dinmont has two career wins on good ground but has finished 10th, 7th and 10th in his last three starts and is hard to catch at his best.

runners_data.name: Westgate Warrior
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 26 days off; has placed twice on good or good-to-firm ground over 5f and posted a win over the trip, but Roy Bowring's yard is 1/4 in 14 days and the layoff, combined with a hold-up style in a slow-pace race, makes progress difficult.

races.paceDynamic: Crocus Time is the confirmed front runner and, with no other confirmed leader to press him, Jack Nicholls (5) can dictate from the front at a controlled, sustainable gallop over this 5f at Thirsk. Irish Dancer and Startling are the likeliest horses to press or sit prominently behind him, but neither is a genuine pace-forcing type, so the tempo is unlikely to be truly searching. This field contains substantially more hold-up types than the map can accommodate at the rear — Knicks, Midnight Lir, Blue Lakota, Albegone, and Invincible Crown are all natural hold-up runners who are shown in midfield purely as a consequence of the race shape, with Midnight Lir and Knicks most likely to secure the better of those tracking positions given their recent form profiles. A moderate-pace 5f on good ground at Thirsk, with one horse in control and no significant pressure, strongly favours the prominent-to-lead profile — a horse that can travel close to Crocus Time without burning energy will be ideally positioned, while genuine closers will have limited ground to make up from a compressed, bunched midfield.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crocus Time Controls Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Crocus Time leads without significant pressure and the pace is steady enough to sustain his advantage to the line.
scenarios.body: Crocus Time has won three of his last five starts and his recent form (13-011) on good ground is outstanding; a stress-free lead at a sensible tempo over 5f plays directly to his strengths.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Overhaul Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Irish Dancer or Startling track closely enough to pounce late as Crocus Time's advantage is gradually pegged back.
scenarios.body: A controlled pace can compress the finish and allow a horse sitting second or third to pounce in the final furlong; Irish Dancer has two wins in this grade over this trip on good ground and Startling showed a win here recently.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Horse Arrives
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely modest and the field bunches, allowing a well-positioned midfield runner to close with a strong late run.
scenarios.body: Midnight Lir and Knicks have both placed multiple times over 5f on good ground and a bunched finish off a slow pace can bring them into play; Dc Cogent also has consistent placed form in similar conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If crowding or positional scrimmaging in a compressed midfield forces horses wide and opens a clear run for a lesser-fancied runner.
scenarios.body: With several redistributed hold-up types all hunting the same ground in the final furlong, interference or traffic problems could allow a runner like Dandy Dinmont or Westgate Warrior to find a gap at the right moment.

watchPoints.text: Crocus Time's early position is critical — if he is allowed to lead uncontested and the early splits are slow, the hold-up runners in the field will have almost no ground to close and he could prove very difficult to peg back.
Startling has a non-runner jockey flag — confirm the replacement rider before the off as a different jockey could alter tactics significantly for a prominently-run horse in a race with limited pace.

With Knicks, Midnight Lir, Blue Lakota, Albegone, and Invincible Crown all natural hold-up types forced into midfield, watch for significant crowding and interference in the closing stages as they all search for the same clear running lane.

Irish Dancer's last win came over 5f on good ground in this grade — if Zak Wheatley can secure a prominent position behind Crocus Time without burning fuel early, the 3lb claim makes him a live player in a compressed finish.

Blue Lakota returns after 29 days — watch for any market move at the track as Kevin Ryan runners can improve sharply on a return to action, and the yard's 14-day strike rate of 4/33 suggests runners are fit enough to be competitive on reappearance.
